title: Figaro Agreement (written and registered forms)
description: The shape of one agreement's document — the clauses a designer selects for one order, each with the designer's own fills (`block.design.fills` values only; `{}` for a clause the designer only selects), beside the designer's words. The document has two forms with one shape. WRITTEN: the designer writes each clause by its name (`name`, or `name@version` where two registered specs share a name), as the files under `agreements/` do; the reference composer is `composeAuthoredAgreement` (sdk/src/projection.ts), which resolves every name to its clause key, checks the one composition rule (one clause of commerce's shape and one of topology's, every composed field value-free in scope), and derives the key. REGISTERED: the pinned document keys every clause by its clause key (keccak256 of the spec's canonical bytes); its `agreementHash` is the merkle root over the composed clause leaves (`agreementHashOf`, sdk/src/assembly.ts), the key `AgreementRegistry.registerAgreement` takes, and a reader recomputes it from the fetched bytes (`anchorRegisteredAgreement`). The editorial fields are excluded from the hash, so renaming never forks the key. A conformance test (sdk/tests/documents/schema-conformance.test.ts) keeps this schema and the composer in lockstep over the reference files. The schema is OPEN (additionalProperties allowed): unknown fields are tolerated and ignored by conforming readers.

name.description: The designer's own words, for a reader; never part of the key.

summary.description: One sentence a stranger reads first; never part of the key.

description.description: The designer's longer telling; never part of the key.

clauses.description: The composed clauses: each key names one clause (WRITTEN: its name or `name@version`; REGISTERED: its 0x-prefixed 32-byte clause key), each value is the designer's fills for it, `{}` when the designer only selects it. At least two: one clause of commerce's shape and one of topology's, the mandatory article every order carries.

clauseKey.description: A clause key: keccak256 of the spec's pinned canonical bytes, the `ClauseRegistry` key.

clauseName.description: A clause written by name as the registry lists it (`clauseId`), with `@<version>` only where two registered specs share the name.

fills.description: The designer's values for the clause's `block.design.fills` fields, keyed by field name; `{}` for a clause the designer only selects. Every other field of the clause is the buyer's at checkout, or a seller's by its profile, never written here.
